# First-Pass Research Packet

## Orientation

The forest-level issue is whether the company can align consent, purpose limitation, vendor controls, and retention with the actual product value. The strongest practical path is a bounded opt-in launch rather than an indefinite raw-audio collection program.

## Viable paths

1. Launch with explicit opt-in, short raw-audio retention, and vendor no-training terms.
2. Launch transcription only and discard raw audio after processing.
3. Delay model-training use until a separate consent and governance path is complete.

## Last-mile verification

Confirm state voice-recording rules, final disclosures, vendor deletion behavior, and whether any minors can use the feature.
